requirements.desc: Set the impl loop review `MAX_LOOP_CALLS` fixed limit to 16.
requirements.note: R1: impl loop review uses fixed MAX_LOOP_CALLS value 16

requirements.desc: When grouped diff count exceeds 16, batch groups so the number of per-chunk AI review calls is at most 16.
requirements.note: R2: grouped diffs above the limit are batched to at most MAX_LOOP_CALLS calls

requirements.desc: Run the cross-check AI pass only when proposals are produced from more than one reviewed chunk.
requirements.note: R3: cross-check runs only for proposals from more than one reviewed chunk

requirements.desc: Do not run the cross-check AI pass when proposals are produced from exactly one reviewed chunk.
requirements.note: R4: single proposal chunk does not run the cross-check pass

requirements.desc: Within one loop review execution, skip the AI call for a chunk whose hash matches an already reviewed chunk input.
requirements.note: R5: duplicate chunk hashes are skipped before another AI call

requirements.desc: Preserve the existing review.md and impl-review.json output formats for recorded impl review findings.
requirements.note: R6: active loop review path still writes through existing impl review artifact helpers

requirements.desc: Wire loop review into the active impl review path so `sdd-forge flow review` executions where `shouldUseLoopReview(touchedFiles.size)` is true use the bounded loop review result before writing review.md and impl-review.json.
requirements.note: R7: active impl review path uses loop review when shouldUseLoopReview is true
